extensions.evidence: Source-derived website-only record: site.css, index.html, app.js, demo.js, content/lore.json, content/roadmap.json, assets/wordmark.svg, scripts/website_content.py, PRODUCT.md, and the website surface brief. No computed-style, screenshot, runtime, gameplay, or visual-acceptance evidence. Runtime and final visual acceptance remain with the user.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.behavior: 20px page padding; 25px page headings; Lore keeps art above copy with a 16px gap; Roadmap uses numeral-only horizontal phases; Demo controls move below the map.

breakpoints.name: compact-docs
breakpoints.behavior: Hide topic sidebar; show a 40px-minimum-height selector; 10px reader gap; article 15px/1.7 and chapter headings 22px/1.3.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.behavior: 16px page padding; 12px theme labels; Home caption 13px, commands 19px, CA 11px; Demo stat values 15px; destination names 14px and icons 28px.

breakpoints.name: low
breakpoints.behavior: 42px toolbar and candle mark; 32px footer line boxes; Home commands 18px/1.15; page headings 24px; hide secondary Demo details.

breakpoints.name: low-narrow
breakpoints.behavior: Restore Demo tools to a row.

breakpoints.name: landscape
breakpoints.behavior: Home becomes two columns beneath the spanning bitmap title capped at 54px; caption 12px and commands 16px; reader actions minimum 32px. Lore keeps one column with artwork above copy and a 10px gap, hides its outer heading, and uses 19px passage headings and 12px/1.5 copy. Roadmap uses 20px headings and 12px/1.4 copy, with outer heading and status hidden. Links uses four columns.

breakpoints.name: short-landscape-demo
breakpoints.behavior: 144px sidebar; two-row 44px touch pad; 36px message row; stat values 13px; message 12px/1.35.

focus.homeCommand: Underline without outline; the selected cursor remains visible.

extensions.elevation: Flat surfaces; no box-shadow system. Candle, paintings, thin rules, and map tones supply depth.
extensions.shortLandscapeDemo: 144px sidebar; two-row 44px touch pad; 36px message row.

headline.purpose: Regular-weight headings above each interior page.

title.purpose: Heading inside the selected guide chapter.

body.purpose: Default proportional copy and inherited controls.

article.purpose: Docs paragraphs, Lore passages, and Roadmap summaries; Docs measure is 68ch and Lore copy width is min(72ch, 100%).

command.purpose: Three direct Home actions with a selected cursor.

code.purpose: Commands in the guide; intentionally uses the same proportional book family.

label.purpose: Theme buttons, compact topic selection, and reader pagination.

fontLoading.scope: Website copy, UI, code, keyboard labels, and canvas glyphs. The inline bitmap Home wordmark uses no font loading or swapping. Native terminal font remains outside this system.

readingLayout.outerShell: 100dvh with 100svh fallback; toolbar/content/footer tracks; hidden outer overflow.
readingLayout.docs: 190px topic column, 32px gap; one selected chapter. The article is the only scrolling reading region; nested command blocks may overflow horizontally. Sidebar and pagination stay stationary.
readingLayout.lore: Eight pages and four wide v2 paintings (1774×887); one painting per two passages. Always one column, artwork above copy, including short landscape. Gap 20px, 16px at width ≤760px, 10px at height ≤420px. Artwork object-fit:contain and object-position:center bottom, without a contrasting panel background. Centered copy width min(72ch, 100%), desktop body 16px/1.7, heading bottom margin 12px. Originals and prompts: CEO-FILES/lore/2026-10-24-v2; earlier artwork is not shipped.
readingLayout.roadmap: Five phases without dates; 240px selector column and 48px gap; one phase and Previous/Next at a time.

canvas.cellSize: floor(min(canvas CSS width / columns, canvas CSS height / rows, 32))
canvas.alignment: Centered square cells with integer CSS coordinates; glyphs centered in each cell.
canvas.fog: Persistent fog and remembered cells remain enabled.

homeWordmark.rendering: Original bitmap/character-art SVG embedded inline by scripts/website_content.py; paths use currentColor, etching uses var(--color-ground), and no wordmark font loads or swaps.
homeWordmark.accessibility: Home h1 aria-label DiggerChain; decorative SVG aria-hidden=true and focusable=false.
homeWordmark.sizing: Container width min(1120px, 100%); SVG width 100%, height auto, max-height clamp(48px, 15dvh, 144px); max-height 54px at height ≤420px.

extensions.homeDownload: Home Download opens #docs/download; the actual archive download remains inside Docs.
extensions.pageCaptions: Secondary captions on Docs, Demo, Roadmap, and Links are omitted.

components.name: Text action
components.description: Direct proportional text action with accent, underline hover, keyboard focus, and muted disabled state.

components.name: Home command
components.description: Selected Home command keeps its cursor and uses the responsive proportional command scale.
components.html: >Play demo

components.name: Theme choice
components.description: Compact palette control; the pressed option uses a rule border and accent lettering.

components.name: Docs topic
components.description: Selected topic uses a quiet surface and an inline stroke icon, matching the desktop topic column.
components.html: Start here

components.name: Compact topic selector
components.description: Labeled square selector replaces Docs topics at width 760px or height 540px and below.
components.html: <label class="ds-topic-label">Topic<select class="ds-topic-select" aria-label="Choose a guide topic"><option>Start here</option><option>Get the game</option><option>Controls</option></select></label>
components.css: .ds-topic-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:var(--color-muted);font:13px/1.55 var(--font-body, 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif)}.ds-topic-select{width:100%;min-height:40px;border:1px solid var(--color-rule);border-radius:0;padding:4px 8px;background:var(--color-ground);color:var(--color-ink);font:13px/1.55 var(--font-body, 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif)}.ds-topic-select:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--color-accent);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Touch control
components.description: Square map action reverses on hover or press and dims when disabled.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-touch" aria-label="Move or dig north">↑</button>

components.name: Footer navigation
components.description: Six equal destinations stay compact; current page and hovered links use the accent.
components.html: HomeLoreRoadmapDocsDemoLinks
components.css: .ds-footer{width:min(720px,100%);margin-inline:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));font:clamp(12px,1.6vw,15px)/38px var(--font-body, 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif);text-align:center}.ds-footer a{color:var(--color-muted);padding-inline:2px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}.ds-footer a+a{border-left:1px solid var(--color-rule)}.ds-footer a:hover,.ds-footer a[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--color-accent)}.ds-footer a:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--color-accent);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-height:660px){.ds-footer{line-height:32px}}

components.name: Project destination
components.description: Thin-bordered destination pairs its actual inline icon with a proportional name and muted status.
components.html: LLMsOpen link
components.css: .ds-destination{display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr);gap:0 16px;align-content:center;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--color-rule);padding:18px 20px;background:transparent;color:var(--color-ink);font:16px/1.55 var(--font-body, 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif);text-decoration:none;text-align:left}.ds-destination-icon{width:36px;height:36px;grid-row:1/3;color:var(--color-ink)}.ds-destination-name{font-size:18px}.ds-destination-status{color:var(--color-muted);font-size:12px}.ds-destination:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--color-accent);background:var(--color-hover);color:var(--color-accent)}.ds-destination:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--color-accent);outline-offset:3px}.ds-destination:disabled{color:var(--color-muted);cursor:default}.ds-destination:disabled .ds-destination-name,.ds-destination:disabled .ds-destination-icon{color:var(--color-muted)}@media(max-width:440px){.ds-destination{grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr);padding:14px 10px;gap:0 10px}.ds-destination-icon{width:28px;height:28px}.ds-destination-name{font-size:14px}.ds-destination-status{font-size:11px}}@media(max-height:420px){.ds-destination{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:10px 8px;text-align:center}}

narrative.overview: An original candle, an original bitmap Home wordmark, strict proportional book typography, and direct text controls form a compact game screen. Three palettes share flat geometry. The fixed viewport surrounds illustrated reading, selected Docs topics, and a themed glyph map.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, Nord, and Solarized Light palettes.
Proportional Libre Baskerville UI and reading, an inline bitmap Home wordmark, and the approved candle asset.
Fixed viewport with paginated illustrated Lore, phase-based Roadmap, and topic-based Docs.
Flat controls and visible keyboard states.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Theme changes update both interface and map through CSS tokens.

rules.name: The Proportional Type Rule
rules.body: Website text, code, UI, and map glyphs share the proportional book family. Only the Home wordmark uses bitmap/character-art lettering; this rule does not alter the user's terminal font.

dos: Do share palette tokens with the demo.
Do keep topic and chapter controls outside the scrolling article.
Do preserve semantic title text and keyboard states.
Do display the complete Lore painting above its passage at every viewport.
donts: Don't extend bitmap or character-art lettering beyond the Home wordmark.
Don't add outer page scrolling or animated transitions.
Don't apply this specification to the native game.
